rules.name: recon-dup-04-view-tenant-only-explain
rules.sql: SELECT 'recon_settle_snapshot' AS table_name, s.business_unit, count(*) AS row_count, count(DISTINCT s.run_id) AS runs, count(DISTINCT s.settlement_date) AS settlement_dates, min(s.settlement_date) AS first_date, max(s.settlement_date) AS last_date FROM opera.recon_settle_snapshot s WHERE s.tenant_id = :tenant GROUP BY s.business_unit UNION ALL SELECT 'recon_actual_snapshot', a.business_unit, count(*), count(DISTINCT a.run_id), count(DISTINCT a.settlement_date), min(a.settlement_date), max(a.settlement_date) FROM opera.recon_actual_snapshot a WHERE a.tenant_id = :tenant GROUP BY a.business_unit ORDER BY 1, 2

SELECT p.view_type, p.business_unit, count(*) AS published_dates, sum(x.n) AS published_rows, max(x.n) AS biggest_date_rows FROM opera.recon_snapshot_pointer p CROSS JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT CASE p.view_type WHEN 'SETTLE_PRICING' THEN (SELECT count(*) FROM opera.recon_settle_snapshot s WHERE s.tenant_id = p.tenant_id AND s.business_unit = p.business_unit AND s.settlement_date = p.settlement_date AND s.run_id = p.published_run_id) WHEN 'SETTLE_ACTUAL_PRICING' THEN (SELECT count(*) FROM opera.recon_actual_snapshot s WHERE s.tenant_id = p.tenant_id AND s.business_unit = p.business_unit AND s.settlement_date = p.settlement_date AND s.run_id = p.published_run_id) ELSE 0 END AS n ) x WHERE p.tenant_id = :tenant AND p.view_type IN ('SETTLE_PRICING', 'SETTLE_ACTUAL_PRICING') GROUP BY p.view_type, p.business_unit ORDER BY p.view_type, p.business_unit

SELECT count(*) AS cache_view_rows, count(DISTINCT h.business_unit) AS business_units, count(DISTINCT h.settlement_date) AS settlement_dates FROM opera.helper_settle_p_and_g_view_cache_table h WHERE h.tenant_id = :tenant
rules.explain: SELECT count(*) FROM opera.helper_settle_pricing_subportfoliovalues_view v WHERE v.tenant_id = :tenant

expect.reason: a count of the view for the tenant should not take more than 30 seconds
the snapshot, pointer and price tables should be read through their indexes
the planner estimates must be close, otherwise it picks nested loops
